class_weights.definition: sqrt of median-frequency balancing (Eigen & Fergus, ICCV 2015): w_c = sqrt(median_k(f_k) / f_c), f_c = n_c / S_c, n_c = seen 10 cm cells of class c, S_c = seen cells of the frames in which c is present; clipped to <= 25; codes 0..7, 255 (not seen) never counted
